item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Sign Letter to Prevent AI-Developed Biological Weapons
item.description: Leading AI labs, executives, and scientists are sending a letter to lawmakers urging them to improve tracking of synthetic DNA sequences that could be used for bioweapons.

item.title: xAI Asks Court to Strip Alleged Grok Deepfake Nudes Victims of Anonymity
item.description: Four people suing Elon Musk's AI firm under pseudonyms due to the risks of being identified may face a difficult choice: Reveal your real names, or drop the lawsuit.

item.description: Spencer Huang, Nvidia’s robotics lead, tells WIRED that the new bot combines the best of both worlds.

item.title: This Is How Trump Finally Signed the AI Executive Order
item.description: After shelving the original executive order last month, Donald Trump finally got on board Monday night.

item.title: Nvidia’s RTX Spark Laptops Look Hell-Bent on Disruption
item.description: The company’s RTX Spark chips might finally turn the “AI PC” into reality.

item.description: Soccer fans on r/WorldCup2026Tickets are using Claude to build DIY ticketing software, exchanging on back channels, and leaving scalpers scrambling.

item.title: Meet Microsoft Scout, Your AI Coworker That Never Logs Off
item.description: Microsoft’s OpenClaw-style agent appears in Teams, just like a human colleague, and automates your dull office tasks.

item.title: Flush With Cash From OpenAI, Opal Is Making an AI-Powered Audio Gadget
item.description: Opal, the company famous for making a fancy webcam, has pivoted to making other consumer electronics. Fueled by big investments from OpenAI and Samsung, it’s working on an audio gadget first.

item.title: The Trump Administration Is at War With Itself Over AI Regulation
item.description: Donald Trump killed an executive order to regulate AI. Now, administration officials and AI executives are trying to figure out if there’s anything left to piece back together.
